verdict.rationale: Statsig documents some of its own features that keep running in the background once configured. Scheduled Rollouts gradually deploy a feature over time, Autotune shifts traffic toward the winning variant automatically, and Infra Analytics alerts catch regressions. These are narrow, feature-specific behaviors rather than a general automation capability. CLI use in CI/CD relies on an external pipeline and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, user-defined triggers and actions, recurring schedules beyond rollouts, autonomous agent-driven background tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
